# Vendored front-end libraries

Bundled locally so the dashboard works without internet access (e.g. over Tailscale only).

| File | Library | Version | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `diff-5.2.0.min.js` | [jsdiff](https://github.com/kpdecker/jsdiff) (`diff` on npm) | 5.2.0 | BSD-3-Clause |
| `highlight-11.9.0.min.js` | [highlight.js](https://highlightjs.org/) common bundle (`@highlightjs/cdn-assets`) | 11.9.0 | BSD-3-Clause |
| `hljs-github-dark.min.css` | highlight.js `github-dark` theme | 11.9.0 | BSD-3-Clause |
